Hextable Dance Inspired by the forms and movement of Antonia Grove and Theo Clinkard, Hextable Dance’s first resident artists, as they worked with choreographer Rafael Bonachela. Commissioned by
Artistic Director, Richard Whistler. Short-listed for The Rowse Kent Public Art Awards, 2006
Landmark East Shortlisted for this East of England Development Agency Competition Exhibition Cambridge Cornmarket
Enduring Love Studio and sculptures featured in the (2004) film ‘Enduring Love’ based on the novel by Ian McEwan directed by Roger Michell and starring Daniel Craig, Bill Nighy and Samantha Morton.
Glenys Barton at Wedgwood An 18 month residency at the Josiah Wedgwood Factory, Barlaston, Stoke-on-Trent, resulting in an exhibition of 26 pieces produced at the factory and publication.
